suite: the DAG zoom, Fit and the grid header
expect_red: [real] a wheel zoom over the drawing never changes the page's scroll

mutations.contract: A wheel zoom never scrolls the document.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_wheel_the_column_and_fit_behave (2026-10-29). Puts the pointer-anchoring compensation back on the page's own scroll.
mutations.find: scrollDag(0, paneScroller() ? after.top + cy * to - clientY : 0);
